subject: error in ragged array example of stan-reference?

messages.author: 3f37be0cf708d442
messages.subject: error in ragged array example of stan-reference?
parts:
Hello,

I think there is a small error in the example for ragged arrays on page 135 of the stan-reference.

the relevant section in the model block of the example reads:

  int pos;
  pos <- 1;
  for (k in 1:K)
    segment(y, pos, s[k]) ~ normal(mu[k], sigma);

which means that the stating index of the slicing operation is always 1.
instead it should probably be something like 

 int pos;
  pos <- 1;
  for (k in 1:K){
    segment(y, pos, s[k]) ~ normal(mu[k], sigma);
    pos <- pos + s[k];
  }


(in figure 2 it should also be "z = [†1:3 2:4 0:9 ..."  and not "y = [†1:3 2:4 0:9 ..." , or better change the figure caption because y is also used in the example model ...)

best - guido
